janvier_by_verse.1: And our Lord said to Abram: Go forth of thy country, and out of thy kindred, and out of thy father's house, and come into a land which I will shew thee.
janvier_by_verse.2: And I will make thee into a great nation, and I will bless thee, and magnify thy name, and thou shalt be blessed.
janvier_by_verse.3: I will bless them that bless thee, and curse them that curse thee, and IN Thee shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
janvier_by_verse.4: Abram therefore went out as our Lord had commanded him, and with him went Lot: seventy five years old was Abraham when he went forth out of Haran.
janvier_by_verse.5: And he took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all the substance which they had possessed, and the souls which they had gotten in Haran: and went forth to go into the land of Chanaan. And when they were come into it.
janvier_by_verse.6: Abram passed through the country unto the place Sichem, as far as the noble vale: and the Chananite was at that time in the country.
janvier_by_verse.7: And our Lord appeared to Abram, and said to him: To thy seed will I give this land. Who builded there an altar to our Lord, that had appeared to him.
janvier_by_verse.8: And marching on from thence to a mountain, that was on the east side of Bethel, there he pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: he builded there also an altar to our Lord, and called upon his name.
janvier_by_verse.9: And Abram went forward going, and proceeding on to the south.
janvier_by_verse.10: And there came a famine in the country: and Abram descended into Ægypt, to be as a pilgrim there: for the famine was very sore in the land.
janvier_by_verse.11: And when he was near to enter into Ægypt, he said to Sarai his wife: I know that thou art a fair woman,
janvier_by_verse.12: and that when the Ægyptians shall see thee, they will say: She is his wife; and they will kill me, and reserve thee.
janvier_by_verse.13: Say therefore, I pray thee, that thou art my sister: that I may be well used for thee, and that my soul may live for thy sake.
janvier_by_verse.14: When Abram therefore was entered into Ægypt, the Ægyptians, saw the woman that she was passing beautiful.
janvier_by_verse.15: And the Princes told Pharao, and praised her to him: and the woman was taken into the house of Pharao.
janvier_by_verse.16: And they used Abram well for her sake. And he had sheep and oxen and he asses, and men servants, and maid servants, and she asses, and Camels.
janvier_by_verse.17: And our Lord scourged Pharao with very sore plagues, and his house, for Sarai Abram's wife.
janvier_by_verse.18: And Pharao called Abram, and said to him: What is this that thou hast done to me? Why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
janvier_by_verse.19: For what cause didst thou say she was thy sister, that I might take her to my wife? Now therefore there is thy wife, take her, and go thy ways.
janvier_by_verse.20: And Pharao gave certain men commandment in the behalf of Abram: and they conducted him, and his wife, and all that he had.
